digest.component_or_area: plan-review model ladder and context-limit escalation
propositions: Sonnet 4.6 and Opus 4.8 share an identical 1,000,000 token context window, making escalation from sonnet to opus a no-op that wastes spend and repeats the same failure at higher pricing
A context-limit failure followed by escalation to opus appears to succeed but silently fails at the identical window, producing a false diagnosis that opus could not fit the input
New function escalation_rungs() filters models_at_or_above() to exclude rungs whose declared window is not strictly greater than the last kept rung, eliminating no-op escalations
Both context-limit retry loops (pass1_with_ladder and run_focused_finder) must consume escalation_rungs() instead of models_at_or_above() to prevent zero-capacity escalations
The ladder's declared windows are factually correct per live Models API verification; the defect is in consumption logic, not table values
